dedupe_keys.name: carbon monitor cities china daily sectoral co2 emissions

description: The Carbon Monitor Cities team publishes daily fossil-fuel and cement CO2 estimates for 48 major Chinese cities. The own Figshare version-two deposit is CC BY 4.0 and contains workbooks with sector estimates and similarity or uncertainty material. The article assigns emissions to power generation, residential and service buildings, industry, ground transport and aviation for 2020–2021. These time series can check activity or emissions assumptions in urban energy and transport scenarios. A caveat is that the values are modelled near-real-time estimates built from activity proxies, not direct exhaust measurements. Changes during lockdowns also reflect weather and economic behaviour, so a simulator should not attribute them to one policy without controls. A separate Figshare deposit covers 1,500 cities globally and should not be conflated with this China-specific version. I read the own Figshare metadata and file names without downloading workbooks, testing uncertainty calculations or reconciling city boundaries. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
